description: DISCO follows charged-particle guiding centres through magnetohydrodynamic simulation output using a GPU. The documented release reads SWMF output and represents several magnetic and electric drift terms, including relativistic particles. The resource is documented by NASA GSFC. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere, High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. MAGE support is described as planned; it must not be recorded as an implemented interface. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
